statement:
∀ (f : ℕ → ℝ → ℝ) (M : ℕ → ℝ),
  Summable M →
    (∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |f k x| ≤ M k) →
      TendstoUniformly (fun n x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f k x) (fun x => ∑' (k : ℕ), f k x) atTop

universal.type: ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |f k x| ≤ M k
universal.name: h

hyps.text: ∀ (k : ℕ) (x : ℝ), |f k x| ≤ M k
hyps.name: h

goal.text: TendstoUniformly (fun n x => ∑ k ∈ Finset.range n, f k x) (fun x => ∑' (k : ℕ), f k x) atTop
